messages:
Rae (CS): Morning team — Helios Systems private VPC cutover day 2. They saw intermittent 502/504s to their internal object-store and called out predictable tail latency as a renewal gating item. Opening CS-7643. Asking ops + security for quick triage and a short customer-facing checklist.

Dimitri V: Just pulled ELB + NATGW traces. Clustered resets and retransmits at 02:14 UTC. Packets >1420 show fragmentation/loss on the path. Likely PMTU blackhole between their edge and our egress.

Helios NetOps: Our tunnel MTU is nominally 1500. Path MTU discovery shows drops beyond 1416. We can flip MSS clamping on the peer for tonight's window and test.

Sofia L: KMS note: Helios has daily key rotation at 02:10 and backups start 02:12. That overlap will produce KMS API bursts and transient decrypt latency. Customer wants concrete mitigation so renewal talks don't get derailed. Options: move rotation post-backup, stagger backup role, or add short-lived decrypt cache for the backup process. Also they want audit events forwarded to their security account and our audit bucket.

Ben (SecEng): Draft IAM/KMS snippet for cross-account decrypt logging (please review with Helios account IDs):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999900001111:role/helios-audit"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444455556666:key/abcd-efgh-1234"
    }
  ]
}
```
I'll also add CloudTrail-to-S3 export steps and recommended retention to the ticket.

Rae (CS): Action list: 1) @Dimitri run short pcap + attach to CS-7643 and ping Helios NetOps for MSS clamp; 2) @Sofia propose KMS rotation options + stub FAQ for onboarding docs; 3) @Ben add audit-export playbook + IAM snippet to ticket. If instability persists >48h mark renewal_risk and loop AM/legal for SLO language.

Dimitri V: Uploaded 25s pcap and annotated ELB timestamps to CS-7643 — traces show PMTU blackhole when payloads exceed ~1420B. Messaged Helios NetOps to apply MSS clamp 1400 for test window.

Helios NetOps: MSS clamp applied for the test window. We'll run this check from a bastion during the next backup and drop traces into CS-7643:
```
curl -sS -w "%{time_connect} %{time_starttransfer} %{http_code}\n" -o /dev/null https://internal-obj.helios:443 --resolve internal-obj.helios:443:10.50.50.12
sudo tcpdump -n -s 0 -c 200 port 443 and host 10.50.50.12
```

Sofia L: Drafted KMS FAQ blurb for onboarding repo: "If backups read objects immediately after key rotation you'll see transient decrypt latency. Recommended patterns: schedule rotation after backups, use a staggered rotation for backup roles, or implement a short decrypt cache in the backup runner." Will PR the one-pager "Network + KMS pre-cutover checklist" and link in CS-7643. ETA EOD.

Ben (SecEng): Added audit-export checklist to CS-7643: enable CloudTrail data events for S3 -> configure cross-account bucket policy -> KMS key grant to audit role -> verify object access logs. I'll include sample bucket policy snippet in ticket.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-7643 updated — assignees: Dimitri V, Sofia L, Ben (SecEng). Status: investigation. Next automated reminder in 8h.

Rae (CS): Captured customer feedback: they appreciate responsiveness but explicitly want a concise pre-cutover checklist and a short KMS rotation FAQ to share with their infra team. They also warned renewal conversations will reference any variance >5% in tail latency. I've added renewal_risk monitoring to the ticket and will escalate to AM/legal if we cross threshold.

Dimitri V: Early telemetry after MSS clamp shows retransmits down ~70% in the 30m sample. We'll validate during next backup window and post results to CS-7643.

Sofia L: PR created with a one-page checklist + KMS FAQ, linking to the audit-export playbook. Pushed to onboarding repo and added link to the ticket.

Rae (CS): Thanks team. Please keep short, customer-facing updates in CS-7643 (no long Slack dumps) so AM has a clean timeline for renewal discussions. If we don't stabilize within 48h I'll schedule the AM/customer call to discuss possible SLO amendment/credits. :warning:
